description: One recipient written two ways - display name, angle brackets, mixed case, mixed-case channel - collapses to one delivery key.
why_it_exists: Without normalisation a display name or a single capital letter in the address made the same delivery look new, and the same letter would be sent twice. normEmail() extracts the address from angle brackets, trims and lowercases; the channel is trimmed and uppercased.

input.sanitisation_note: The original fixture used "Claims Team <InsurerClaims01@Example.COM>"; the replacement preserves the 27-character address length and the mixed-case display-name shape.

assertions: send_key is identical to the plain-lowercase first-send key
normEmail() strips the display name and angle brackets and lowercases the address
the channel is uppercased before entering the basis
